about.title: About DeHoyos Accident Attorneys
text: If you’ve been injured in a car accident, slip and fall incident, dog bite attack or suffered another personal injury in Houston, Texas, you deserve a personal injury settlement that covers all your needs and expenses. If another person’s negligence, recklessness, or carelessness caused your injury, the Houston personal injury lawyers at DeHoyos Accident Attorneys, PLLC can make sure you don’t suffer the personal and financial consequences alone.

At Houston personal injury law firm, DeHoyos Accident Attorneys, PLLC, claiming fair compensation for accident victims is all we do. We take our clients’ situations personally and make it our mission to work meticulously to maximize the compensation they receive. Unlike larger personal injury law firms in Houston, which prioritize quick settlements over higher compensation, DeHoyos Accident Attorneys works harder to maximize the settlements our clients receive so they not only recover quickly, they also recover comfortably.

Our deep insight into personal injury law in Houston, Texas, combined with a firm understanding of the local courts and procedures in the Houston area, lead to winning legal strategies that maximize personal injury settlements for our clients.
